subject: POC plan + risk tracker (Stellar Commerce) - action items & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan + risk tracker (Stellar Commerce) - action items & next steps

Hi Sarah / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Per our discussion, attached is the initial POC plan (Stellar_POC_plan_v1.docx) and a living risk tracker (POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx). Below is a concise recap and the proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

POC goal / success criteria
- Validate Redwood’s hosted inference for product search ranking at 95th percentile latency <= 120ms for 512-token requests under your representative workload;
- Demonstrate <10% regression in relevance (as measured by Stellar’s QA testset A/B) compared to baseline;
- End-to-end integration with Stellar’s staging environment and SSO auth/config validation.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): access & environment prep — staging credentials, sample dataset, and S3 access (owner: Carlos).
- Week 1: model onboarding + smoke tests (owner: Marcus / Dev).
- Week 2-3: load testing and quality evals (owner: Evelyn / Marissa).
- Week 4: final review + handoff and recommendations (owner: Marissa).

Ownership & contacts
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole — marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
- Solutions/SE: Marcus Lin — marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
- Backend engineer (integration): Dev Patel — dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
- Customer success: Evelyn Hart — evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com

Key immediate asks for Stellar
- Please share staging API credentials and the agreed sample dataset (CSV) by EOD Wed 8/26.
- Confirm point of contact for networking (VPC / firewall) to ensure we can reach the Staging S3 endpoints.

Risks identified (high level)
- S1: Staging VPC egress blocked — blocks end-to-end tests (mitigation: temporary proxy or whitelist Redwood IP range).
- S2: SSO/OAuth mismatch — may delay auth verification (mitigation: exchange SAML metadata; fallback to API key in staging).
- S3: Data schema mismatch — could affect eval results (mitigation: small schema mapping step + sample verification).

I’ve populated the initial rows in the attached POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx (owner/priority/mitigation/escalation path). Please review and add any risks on your side.

Next step: propose 30-min follow-up Wed 8/26 at 10am PT to confirm access and ownership — is that OK?

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@stellarcommerce.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan + risk tracker (Stellar Commerce) - action items & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap and the attachments. We’re excited to move forward. Quick updates from our side:

- Staging dataset: Carlos will drop the sample CSV into the shared S3 folder by EOD today.
- Networking: our infra lead is out today, but I flagged the need to whitelist Redwood’s IPs — I expect a response tomorrow.
- SSO: one potential blocker — our STAGE SAML provider uses a different ACS URL pattern than prod and we’ve had mismatches with vendors before. If we can’t get SAML working quickly, we’ll need a short-lived API key for the trial.

Also flagged an item in the risk tracker: the staging environment enforces a strict CORS policy that has caused issues in other integrations. I’ll add a row later today.

Wed 8/26 10am PT works for Sarah & Carlos — please send calendar invite.

—Sarah
Sarah Johnson
Director of Product Ops | Stellar Commerce

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan + risk tracker (Stellar Commerce) - action items & next steps

Thanks Sarah — quick technical note on the SSO/CORS items:

- SSO: we can absolutely accept a short-lived API key for staging as a fallback while SAML metadata is exchanged. Request: send the API key over the S3 staging config or secure secret manager (do not email token).
- CORS: if staging is blocking browser-based flows, we can run tests server-side or via a lightweight proxy. Marcus and I can validate both approaches during Week 1 smoke tests.

I added a new sheet in POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx (tab: technical_notes) with the temporary workarounds and ownership. For the VPC egress risk (S1) — if we can’t get whitelisting soon, we’ll ask for a temporary SSH jumpbox (or we can provide a managed proxy).

If your infra team can share a small connectivity test (curl to our /health endpoint) that would speed verification. I’ve attached a short network-troubleshoot-output.txt template with the exact curl we’d run.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Backend Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: POC plan + risk tracker (Stellar Commerce) - action items & next steps

Thanks team — I’ve updated the tracker with the items Dev called out and added escalation paths / SLAs for the top two risks:

POC_Risk_Tracker.xlsx (summary rows added)
- S1 (VPC egress blocked): Priority = High | Owner = Carlos (Stellar) / Dev (Redwood) | Mitigation = temporary managed proxy or whitelist Redwood IPs | Escalation = CS manager (Evelyn) + Redwood infra lead (Rishi) — SLA: 48 hours to enable workaround before we escalate to execs.
- S2 (SSO mismatch): Priority = Medium | Owner = Sarah (Stellar) / Marcus (Redwood) | Mitigation = exchange SAML metadata + API key fallback | Escalation = Product Ops lead (Sarah) + Marissa — SLA: 5 business days.
- S3 (CORS / schema): Priority = Low/Medium | Owner = Carlos / Dev | Mitigation = server-side tests + mapping script.

Action items assigned (short list)
- Carlos: upload sample CSV to S3 + share staging creds (due 2026-08-25 23:59 PT).
- Stellar infra: run the connectivity curl in network-troubleshoot-output.txt and paste results in the shared Drive doc (due 2026-08-26 12:00 PT).
- Marcus/Dev: begin model onboarding on our dev cluster once access is confirmed (target 2026-08-27).
- Evelyn: schedule mid-point evaluation sync for 2026-09-08.

I’ve sent a calendar invite for Wed 8/26 10am PT — please accept. I’ll re-share the Drive link in the invite and make the tracker editable for Stellar.

If anything changes, flag here and we’ll adjust the tracker.

Best,
Marissa

I’ll keep the tracker updated; thank you both for giving us the API key fallback — that keeps us on schedule. See you on the call this afternoon.

—Marissa
